CARD-T-19 (M1) now closes with its row `hypothesis` and states that this bead's catalogue row 'Inertia tables of a model' moves it. Nothing here does that yet. The acceptance lines and the `--stage certify` pass cover kernels, by symbolic execution of straight-line programs, and an inertia table is model data. Please add a stage, an acceptance line and a unit test. For every body of each reference robot's compiled model, write T-19's bundle in the card's format: the `rational-ldlt` factorization of the 4×4 pseudo-inertia with its four pivots, plus the mass-support inequality ρ² − ‖c − o‖² − tr(I_C)/(2m) ≥ 0 over the declared mass envelope. Each bundle must replay in `frob-verify`, and the receipt moves T-19's row to `checked`, class `Certified`. A planted body with a non-positive pivot must yield no certificate. Add CARD-T-19 to deps so the stage reads the card's format (M1; no path back, checked). Without this, T-19 stays `hypothesis` for ever, and so does every result that cites it as `Certified`.

CARD-T-29 now states that this bead depends on it and writes the wiring certificate of each design it checks. Your Evidence paragraph already promises 'Certified as instance certificates of T-29', but no bead writes those bundles, so that class could never be reached. Please add deps CARD-T-29 and BD-027 (M1 and M0; no path back, checked). At stage 5 (`wiring::check_structure`), for each admitted design (at least the worked leg-on-quadruped and N15b-33's admitted fixtures), write the `poly-identity` bundle in T-29's format: B and C with ψᵀ(CᵀB)φ = 0, the wiring relations as primitive equations, the topological order and the edge list from declared causality. Add acceptance lines saying that `frob-verify` accepts each bundle, that the card's law tests (`crates/frob-lemma/tests/cards/t29.rs`) pass against `check_structure`, and that the receipt moves T-29's row from `hypothesis` to `checked`. Also assert that the auditor's verdict on T-29's mutation fixtures agrees with your FROB-REF-108 refusals. The three design-side defects are reversed sign, copied power port and algebraic loop; the missing-relation mutant has no design-side counterpart.
